title: Old single-pane windows and a patio slider, replaced
summary: Dual-pane vinyl throughout, including the sliding patio door. The condensation goes out with the old glass.
beforeAlt: An Agoura Hills home before the work, with old aluminum-framed windows and a dated sliding patio door.
alt: The same elevation after new dual-pane vinyl windows and a replacement sliding patio door were fitted.
